content: Akatumiche chaba bha kunane kwa Chapanga na mabulo chaba

Kuhumii peniya, nikawene nginyililo henge ngolongwa ya kukangacha hake kunane kwa Chapanga. Pakibha na akatumiche bha kunane bhina mabulo chaba gha kujhomolela. Kwa mabulo gheniya chaba, lindoghondogho lya Chapanga likamilike.

Kabhele nakawene kilebhe chikilandana na mbwane jha lindala, jhihanganike na mwotu. Nakawe helahela bhala bhando bhubhakihotwii kinyama chela pamonga na kinyagho chake na liina lyake likalongilwe kwa jhela ichabo. Bhando bheniya bhubhakibha bhajhemite muupele jha mbwane jhene jha lindala, bhakamwii malimba ghibhapilwe na Chapanga.
Bhajhembita nhwambo gwa Mucha, ntumiche gwa Chapanga na nhwambo gwa Mwanalimbelele,

content.text: itendwa hino ndi ikolongwa na ya kukangacha hake!
Mwe Munahota nkolongwa jwa machiko ghoha ghangapeta,
ndela jhino ndi jha uchakaka na ihobholeka!
Nhwalo mwenga kanjika chino ndi manyahinyahi.
nhwalo itendwa hino ya uchakaka iyekulilwe kwa bhando bhoha.”

content: Pighapetita gheniya, nikaiwene Nyumba jha Chapanga idindulilwe kunane na nkate jhake kukibha na Lihema lililangii Chapanga abhile.
Peniya, ngabhapitita akatumiche chaba bha kunane kwa Chapanga mu Nyumba jhene bhina mabulo chaba. Bhakibha bhawalite ngobho nhuo ing'anyima na luhunga lwa chaabo mu ibhuno yabhe.
Na jhumo panakate jha ihumbi hela ncheche bhubhabhii ghome ngabhapila bhala akatumiche bha Chapanga chaba mabakule chaba gha chaabo ghatwelii lilaka lya Chapanga, jwaitama machiko ghoha ghangapeta.

Nyumba jha Chapanga ngaitwelila lyoi nhwalo gwa ukolo gwa Chapanga na makakala ghake, na akibha jhe mundo jwakahotwii kujhingii mu Nyumba jha Chapanga ade pighajhomokila mabulo chaba ghighaletitwa na akatumiche chaba bha kunane kwa Chapanga.
